inspire.name: Inspire
inspire.des: Enhances Basic Attack speed and physical penetration.

flicker.name: Flicker
flicker.des: Teleports a short distance. Gains hybrid defense briefly.

retribution.name: Retribution
retribution.des: Deals true damage to creeps. Essential for Jungling.

purify.name: Purify
purify.des: Removes CC/debuffs instantly. Grants speed and CC immunity.

petrify.name: Petrify
petrify.des: Stuns surrounding enemies for 0.8s and slows them.

execute.name: Execute
execute.des: Deals true damage based on target's missing HP.

aegis.name: Aegis
aegis.des: Generates a shield for the hero and lowest-HP nearby ally.

revitalize.name: Revitalize
revitalize.des: Summons a healing spring that restores HP to allies.

flameshot.name: Flameshot
flameshot.des: Knocks back close enemies and snipes distant targets.

vengeance.name: Vengeance
vengeance.des: Gains damage reduction and reflects physical damage.

sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.des: Massively increases movement speed and grants slow immunity.

arrival.name: Arrival
arrival.des: Teleports to a friendly turret or minion after a channel.
